text: Blockchain creates a data protection paradox: the technology itself offers strong privacy protection, yet storing blockchain data across a global network of nodes will often violate specific consumer protection rules and directives in individual jurisdictions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: While blockchain technology itself offers unprecedented genuine data and privacy protection, the storage of blockchain data across a global network of nodes often will not comply with specific consumer protection rules, directives, and guidelines around the world.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies where consumer protection or data protection rules impose jurisdiction specific storage requirements
